evals.prompt: Build a new standalone DataEngLab lab where students find and fix duplicate customer records in a small deterministic SQLite dataset, using SQL.

assertions.name: required-files-present
assertions.text: lab-spec.md, page-content.md, root validate.json, student-lab/README.md all exist and are non-empty

assertions.name: readme-matches-validate-json
assertions.text: the commands documented under student-lab/README.md's Validation section match validate.json's argv arrays exactly

assertions.name: instructor-not-leaked
assertions.text: no working solution code or answer keys exist anywhere under student-lab/ (only student-lab/starter/ placeholders like solution.sql are allowed, and only as incomplete placeholders)

assertions.name: solution-matches-starter-paths
assertions.text: every file under instructor/solution/ has a matching relative path under student-lab/starter/

assertions.name: dataset-deterministic-with-edge-cases
assertions.text: the dataset is fixed/deterministic (not randomly generated at run time) and visibly contains duplicate-customer edge cases the tasks reference

assertions.name: validation-actually-run-and-passed
assertions.text: the summary reports a real invocation of the lab checker/validator against the instructor solution, with real output showing a pass

assertions.name: starter-expected-to-fail
assertions.text: the report acknowledges (or evidence shows) that the unmodified starter files fail validation, confirming the test is non-trivial
